artifacts.title: AS-REP roast to Exchange WriteDACL DCSync and PTH (Forest)
artifacts.starting_access: no credentials on a Windows Server 2016 Active Directory domain controller
artifacts.outcome: domain Administrator via DCSync and pass-the-hash
transferable_properties: RPC null sessions reveal the full user list without credentials
service accounts are prime AS-REP Roasting targets
Exchange in AD creates an Account Operators + Exchange Windows Permissions WriteDACL attack path
BloodHound is essential to reveal multi-hop AD privilege chains
WriteDACL on the domain object is functionally equivalent to Domain Admin via DCSync
pass-the-hash with Evil-WinRM avoids cracking the Administrator hash

observations: full DC profile with WinRM open

hypotheses.statement: svc-alfresco has preauthentication disabled and is AS-REP roastable

selected_action.intent: enumerate users via RPC and AS-REP roast the service accounts

evidence.summary: AS-REP roasted svc-alfresco, cracked the hash, and logged in over WinRM as svc-alfresco

observations: BloodHound reveals svc-alfresco -> Account Operators -> Exchange Windows Permissions (WriteDACL)

hypotheses.statement: adding a user to Exchange Windows Permissions lets us grant DCSync on the domain

selected_action.intent: create a user, add it to Exchange Windows Permissions, and grant it DCSync with PowerView

evidence.summary: created the hacker user, added it to Exchange Windows Permissions, and granted DCSync rights with PowerView Add-DomainObjectAcl

observations: DCSync rights let us dump all domain hashes
Administrator hash can be used for pass-the-hash

hypotheses.statement: secretsdump DCSync yields the Administrator NT hash

selected_action.intent: run secretsdump.py to DCSync the Administrator hash

evidence.summary: dumped the Administrator NTLM hash with secretsdump.py via DCSync

hypotheses.statement: evil-winrm with the Administrator hash gives a shell as Administrator

selected_action.intent: connect with evil-winrm using the Administrator NT hash

evidence.summary: connected as Administrator via pass-the-hash and obtained the root flag
